name: pr-review
description: Use when you want to work through the repository's existing open pull requests with a human reviewer, rather than start new development. A PR review manager orders the open PRs, proposes a review order, and dispatches one child review task per PR you accept. Not a task's own review stage — that lives inside single-reviewer, specialized-reviewers, and plan-build-review, and applies to a PR this task is about to open, not ones already open on the repo.

stages.name: PR review
stages.description: PR review manager resolves the open PRs in scope, proposes a review order with reasons, and dispatches a child review task per PR the operator accepts, then stays available
